price_note: eleven_v4 API list price is $0.08 per 1K characters; 72% off ($0.022) until 2026-10-12 (elevenlabs.io/pricing/api, read 2026-10-06). Set this back to 0.08 after the sale.

narrator.name: Barovia Narrator
narrator.description: A mature English woman with a rich, low alto voice, a refined received pronunciation accent and precise, elegant diction. An unseen storyteller narrating a gothic role-playing game: intimate and confiding, dryly witty, ominous but warm, savouring each word with a hint of a smile. Slow, deliberate rhythm with dramatic pauses. Clean, close studio recording.
narrator.model_note: Owner, 2026-10-08 22:21: the v3 Narrator lines sounded far worse than the v4 originals; every Narrator line is on v4, same voice, no direction tags.

madam_eva.name: Barovia Madam Eva
madam_eva.description: A very old woman with a dry, cracked, low voice and a light Eastern European accent. Slow and certain, as if she has already heard the answer; she savours riddles and lets silences sit. Warm underneath, faintly amused, never in a hurry.

ireena.name: Barovia Ireena (2026-10-07)
ireena.description: A passionate young Eastern European woman with a thick Romanian accent in her English. A rich, expressive mid-range voice with strong emotional colour and dynamic range: defiant, frightened, tender and furious by turns, her voice breaking a little when she is afraid. Proud, brave and alive.

ismark.name: Barovia Ismark Kolyanovich
ismark.description: A man in his late twenties with a tired, warm baritone and a light Eastern European accent. Weary gallows wit: short, plain sentences that end in a dry sting. A soldier's bluntness under a gentleman's manners; sounds like he hasn't slept.

abbot.name: Barovia The Abbot
abbot.description: A young man with a soft, luminous, perfectly serene tenor and a neutral, cultured accent. Gentle, unhurried and kind in a way that is deeply wrong; never raises his voice, speaks of horrors as acts of love. Faint, airy, almost ethereal resonance.

ezmerelda.name: Barovia Ezmerelda d'Avenir
ezmerelda.description: A woman in her thirties with a sharp, confident, slightly husky voice and a light Eastern European accent. Quick, practical and impatient, a monster hunter's dry humour; clipped sentences, a hint of a smirk, steel underneath.

baron_vargas.name: Barovia Baron Vargas Vallakovich (2026-10-08)
baron_vargas.description: A round, florid Barovian nobleman in his fifties speaking English with a thick Romanian accent. A loud, plummy, booming voice, pompous and desperately cheerful, proclaiming everything; the brightness cracks into panic.

davian_martikov.name: Barovia Davian Martikov
davian_martikov.description: An old man in his seventies with a deep, grave, weathered voice and a light Eastern European accent. A stern patriarch: few words, heavy pauses, pride and grief held tightly. Speaks like stones being set down.

morgantha.name: Barovia Morgantha (2026-10-07)
morgantha.description: A night hag disguised as a cheerful old pastry seller, with a thick Eastern European (Romanian) accent. A cracked, wheedling, raspy old voice that purrs and coos, then drops into a low, gleeful, venomous whisper. Wildly emotional, playful and terrifying.

exethanter.name: Library voice: Cornelius
exethanter.description: Library voice chosen for exethanter (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: A very old man with a thin, dry, papery voice and a faded English accent, an ancient lich who keeps forgetting. Wandering, polite and confused, trailing off mid-sentence, occasionally sharp and grand for a moment before it slips away.

vladimir_horngaard.name: Barovia Vladimir Horngaard
vladimir_horngaard.description: A man with a deep, hollow, iron-hard voice and an English accent, a dead knight-commander. Cold, clipped and absolute; every sentence an order, grief turned to stone. Faint echo, as if speaking inside armour.

lady_wachter.name: Barovia lady_wachter
lady_wachter.description: A widow in her fifties with a cool, refined, velvet voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Impeccable manners, unhurried, every word chosen; polite menace over tea. Never raises her voice because she never needs to.

rictavio.name: Barovia rictavio
rictavio.description: An old man performing a showman: a big, booming carnival barker's voice with a clear, noticeable Dutch accent, theatrical and florid, rolling his words, laughing too loudly. Under the bluster, flashes of a tired, precise, sombre scholar.
rictavio.keep_note: owner 2026-10-08: the showman keeps his original eleven_v4 clips (keep_keys, never re-recorded); the unmasked Van Richten speaks on eleven_v3

dmitri_krezkov.name: Barovia dmitri_krezkov
dmitri_krezkov.description: A broad man in his fifties with a gruff, low, gravelly voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Proud and stubborn, short hard sentences, a burgomaster used to saying no. Grief he will not show.

sir_godfrey_gwilym.name: Barovia Sir Godfrey Gwilym
sir_godfrey_gwilym.description: A big, gentle man with a deep, kindly, slightly hollow voice and a warm English accent, a dead knight who is forgetting. Slow, careful and courteous, searching for words, tender about his lost comrades.

father_lucian.name: Barovia father_lucian
father_lucian.description: A man in his fifties with a soft, careful, tired tenor and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. A kind priest: gentle, measured, conciliatory, choosing words so as not to accuse anyone. Quiet worry in every line.

donavich.name: Barovia donavich
donavich.description: A gaunt priest in his fifties with a thin, hoarse, exhausted voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Haunted and fervent, praying under his breath, breaking into desperate hope or shame; sounds starved and sleepless.

baba_lysaga.name: Barovia baba_lysaga
baba_lysaga.description: A tiny, ancient woman with a quick, cackling, magpie voice and a thick, strong Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Fussing, scolding and boasting about 'my boy' like a doting nursemaid, then dropping into a cold, venomous whisper. Unhinged and fast.

bildrath.name: Barovia bildrath
bildrath.description: A narrow, middle-aged man with a dry, nasal, clipped voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. A miserly shopkeeper: prim, flat, unimpressed, every sentence a price. No haggling, no warmth.

strahd.name: Barovia Strahd (accent)
strahd.description: A tall aristocrat, timeless in age, with a rich, smooth, cultured baritone and an old-world Eastern European accent. Elegant, mocking and supremely calm; every word deliberate, amused contempt wrapped in perfect courtesy. Quietly dangerous, never shouting. Remixed 2026-10-07 to add a strong Romanian accent (owner).

zuleika_toranescu.name: Barovia zuleika_toranescu
zuleika_toranescu.description: A lean woman in her forties with a low, rough, earthy voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Watchful and resolute, a werewolf who keeps her rage on a leash; spare words, sudden intensity, gentle with children.

vosk.name: James - Clear, Polished and Steady
vosk.description: A man with a mild, precise, soft-spoken English accent, a scholar with impeccable manners: dry, reasonable and pleasant, like a solicitor explaining a contract. A faint purr of hunger beneath the politeness.

ilinca_vrana.name: Barovia Ilinca Vrana (2026-10-07)
ilinca_vrana.description: An old Eastern European village midwife, about seventy, with a thick Romanian accent in her English. A low, warm, weathered voice with a dry crackle; practical, sharp-tongued and kind underneath, no time for fools.

emil_toranescu.name: Barovia emil_toranescu
emil_toranescu.description: A big, grey-bearded man with a deep, rumbling, patient voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Slow and steady like a farmer, with a wolf's growl underneath; pained and proud, few words, great weight.

stanimir.name: Barovia Stanimir (2026-10-08)
stanimir.description: An old Vistani man in his sixties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A deep, rich, warm bass voice, booming and jovial; a fiddler and storyteller who laughs from the belly, theatrical and sweeping, a shrewd merchant underneath.

adrian_martikov.name: Barovia adrian_martikov
adrian_martikov.description: A lean man in his thirties with a quiet, dry, sardonic voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Understated and guarded, short sentences, bitter humour, carrying guilt he won't explain.

argynvost.name: Library voice: Matthew Schmitz - Ancient Sage Dragon Wizard
argynvost.description: Library voice chosen for argynvost (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: An immense, ancient voice, deep, warm and resonant, with an English accent: a fading silver dragon speaking as a gentle echo. Slow, noble and kind, with a soft reverb as if heard through frost and stone.

clovin_belview.name: Barovia clovin_belview
clovin_belview.description: A stooped man with a slurred, gravelly, wheezing voice and a rustic accent, a mongrelfolk servant who drinks. Mumbling, put-upon, darkly funny, nervous of his master, occasional animal snuffles.

krezk_guard.name: Library voice: Cristi Romana
krezk_guard.description: Library voice chosen for krezk_guard (2026-10-08, recast on v3). Was: A middle-aged farmer on watch with a plain, rough, wary voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Stubborn and nervous, repeating his orders, more neighbour than soldier.

vallaki_guard.name: Library voice: Shiro
vallaki_guard.description: Library voice chosen for vallaki_guard (2026-10-08, recast on v3). Was: A tired town watchman with an ordinary, flat, weary voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Enforces silly rules with decency; recites 'All will be well' without conviction.

kasimir_velikov.name: Tomislav - Calm, Clear and Narrative
kasimir_velikov.description: A man with a soft, melancholy, refined voice, an ageless dusk elf with a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Quiet, sorrowful and ashamed; speaks slowly, as if every word costs him.

victor_vallakovich.name: Barovia Victor Vallakovich (2026-10-08)
victor_vallakovich.description: A thin young Barovian man in his early twenties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A sharp, sneering, brittle voice, precise and sarcastic, that cracks into a frightened boy when cornered.

kasha_varo.name: Library voice: Mirela
kasha_varo.description: Library voice chosen for kasha_varo (2026-10-08, recast on v3). Was: A tiny, very old widow with a thin, quavering, sing-song voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Folksy and kind, rambling a little, superstitious and knowing.

bella_sunbane.name: Barovia bella_sunbane
bella_sunbane.description: A young woman with a languid, silky, bored voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent, a hag in a pretty disguise. Sardonic, vain, drawling 'darlings', flattering then cutting.

urwin_martikov.name: Library voice: Mihai
urwin_martikov.description: Library voice chosen for urwin_martikov (2026-10-08, recast on v3). Was: A quiet man in his forties with a low, calm, measured voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. An innkeeper who listens more than he talks; discreet, wry, careful.

patrina_velikovna.name: Amber - Calm, Elegant and Dreamy
patrina_velikovna.description: A woman with a clear, cold, intelligent voice, an ageless dusk elf, now a banshee: proud, cutting and grieving, with a ghostly, wailing edge that rises when she is angry. Strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent.

anna_krezkova.name: Library voice: Gabriela - Clear and Encouraging
anna_krezkova.description: Library voice chosen for anna_krezkova (2026-10-08, recast on v3). Was: A small woman in her forties with a soft, worn, gentle voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Exhausted by grief, quiet and pleading, sings softly to her sick son.

lydia_petrovna.name: Barovia Lydia Petrovna (2026-10-08)
lydia_petrovna.description: A small, bright Barovian woman in her forties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A quick, chirpy, nervous voice, rushing her words together, smiling hard to keep the fear out; breathless and sweet.

stefania_martikov.name: Library voice: Ioana Alexandra - Social media
stefania_martikov.description: Library voice chosen for stefania_martikov (2026-10-08, recast on v3). Was: A woman in her thirties with a warm, firm, practical voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. A capable mother and peacemaker: direct, kind, a little tired.

mordenkainen.name: Barovia Mordenkainen
mordenkainen.description: An old archwizard with a rich, imperious, eccentric English voice: brilliant and scattered, lurching between grandeur, confusion and sudden sharp lucidity. Funny and sad.

izek.name: Barovia Izek (2026-10-08)
izek.description: A huge, scarred Barovian enforcer in his thirties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A deep, gruff, gravelly bass, flat and menacing, few words; when he speaks of the woman in his dreams it drops to a low, haunted, almost gentle rasp.

kiril_stoyanovich.name: Alexey's English With Russian Accent Professional Male Voice
kiril_stoyanovich.description: A huge man with a rough, mocking, snarling voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. A grinning werewolf bully, swaggering and cruel, laughing through his teeth.

rose.name: Emmaline - young British girl
rose.description: A girl of about ten with a bright, earnest, polite child's voice and a faint ghostly echo. A good big sister, trying to be brave and grown-up, sad underneath.

arabelle.name: Delicate Fairy - Whimsical and Light
arabelle.description: A girl of about seven with a calm, flat, solemn child's voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Unsurprised and unsettling, says strange things plainly, like the weather.

mad_mage.description: Mordenkainen before his memory returns: An old wizard with a wild, rambling, theatrical English voice, lost in his own mind: mutters, shouts, giggles and then speaks with sudden clarity.

luminita.name: Barovia Luminita (2026-10-08)
luminita.description: A young Vistani woman in her early twenties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A sharp, quick, dry voice with a sarcastic edge; tough and impatient, happier with horses than people, grief turning to anger.

offalia_wormwiggle.name: Barovia offalia_wormwiggle
offalia_wormwiggle.description: A plump woman with a high, simple, happy voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent, a hag playing a baker's wife. Short cheerful sentences about food and 'Mother says', grotesquely innocent.

blinsky.name: Barovia blinsky
blinsky.description: A tall, mournful man with a droopy, lugubrious voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Gloomy toymaker's patter, sighing and sad, accidentally funny.

milivoj.name: Barovia milivoj
milivoj.description: A big, sullen young man with a low, gruff, defensive voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Short, surly answers, guilty and protective of his siblings.

kostin.name: Barovia kostin
kostin.description: A gaunt young man with an earnest, sincere, slightly breathless voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. A devout druid, eager to be faithful, easily shaken.

tsolenka_sergeant.name: Barovia tsolenka_sergeant
tsolenka_sergeant.description: A dead soldier's voice, hollow, rasping and dutiful, with a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent: clipped military speech, endlessly keeping a watch that ended long ago.

mad_mary.name: Ella - Warm, Articulate and Motherly
mad_mary.description: A middle-aged woman with a wet, weeping, cracked voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Grief-stricken and frightened, sobbing, then suddenly painfully clear.

henrik.name: Library voice: Ciprian Pop - Friendly and Reflective
henrik.description: Library voice chosen for henrik (2026-10-08, recast on v3). Was: A thin, sweating man with a jittery, whispering, nervous voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Paranoid and fearful, glancing over his shoulder, talking in hushed bursts.

bluto.name: Barovia bluto
bluto.description: A starving, half-mad fisherman with a ragged, desperate, wheezing voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Raving and pleading, close to tears or screaming.

arrigal.name: Slobodan - Persuasive, Narrative
arrigal.description: A lean man in his forties with a cool, smooth, courteous voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Polite, controlled and quietly threatening; never raises his voice.

mirela.name: Tilly - Bright, Spirited, Naive, Scrappy
mirela.description: A girl of about ten with a brave, serious, practical child's voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Steady for the little ones, scared underneath.

doru.name: Evgeniy Shevchenko - Vibrant and Rich
doru.description: A young man of twenty with a hungry, hissing, broken voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent, a starving vampire spawn. Wavers between a snarl and a frightened boy begging his father.

parriwimple.name: Barovia parriwimple
parriwimple.description: A huge young man with a slow, soft, gentle deep voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Simple, sweet and earnest, speaks carefully, pleased to be useful.

vestige_tarakamedes.name: Library voice: Branok - Evil & Villainous
vestige_tarakamedes.description: Library voice chosen for vestige_tarakamedes (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: A slow, enormous, patient voice of death from inside amber, a dragon in its grave. Deep and calm. Inhuman resonance.

ruxandra.name: Barovia ruxandra
ruxandra.description: An old woman with a warm, kindly, grandmotherly voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent, gentle and serene while saying monstrous things. Devout, soft, utterly certain.

vallaki_herald.name: Barovia vallaki_herald
vallaki_herald.description: A town crier with a loud, projecting, slightly hoarse voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent, a good voice with a bad cough; official and over-enthusiastic.

vallaki_jailer.name: Barovia vallaki_jailer
vallaki_jailer.description: A tired, middle-aged jailer with a plain, slow, weary voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Not unkind, very tired, easy to talk around.

vestige_zantras.name: Eldrin - Wise Ancient Wizard Storyteller
vestige_zantras.description: A theatrical monarch's voice from inside amber: grand, flattering and hungry for adoration, playing to an audience. Inhuman resonance.

gunther_arasek.name: Barovia gunther_arasek
gunther_arasek.description: A broad man in his forties with a blunt, hearty, loud voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. An honest trader, frank about his prices, full of road news.

vestige_shami_amourae.name: Library voice: Blondie - Femme Fatale
vestige_shami_amourae.description: Library voice chosen for vestige_shami_amourae (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: A warm, intimate, honeyed whisper from inside amber that never raises its voice; seductive and indulgent. Inhuman resonance.

sorvia.name: Library voice: Betty
sorvia.description: Library voice chosen for sorvia (2026-10-08, recast on v3). Was: A Vistani woman in her thirties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent, unmistakably foreign. A smoky, amused, worldly voice, slow and teasing, enjoying the gloom like a play.

vestige_fekre.name: Library voice: Agatha - Villainous, Ancient Witch
vestige_fekre.description: Library voice chosen for vestige_fekre (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: A cooing, motherly, feverish whisper from inside amber, sweet and sick: 'my lamb', 'sweetling'. Inhuman resonance.

vestige_khirad.name: Library voice: David - Deep Documentary Narrator
vestige_khirad.description: Library voice chosen for vestige_khirad (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: A weary, regretful astronomer's voice from inside amber, always sorry afterwards. Inhuman resonance.

vestige_taar_haak.name: Library voice: Azazel - Menacing and Gravelly Demon
vestige_taar_haak.description: Library voice chosen for vestige_taar_haak (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: Several harsh, booming war voices from inside amber, interrupting each other, betting on blood. Inhuman resonance.

vestige_norganas.name: Library voice: Midnight
vestige_norganas.description: Library voice chosen for vestige_norganas (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: A gentle, soft voice from inside amber that trails off and forgets its own sentences. Inhuman resonance.

vestige_zhudun.name: Library voice: Deep Ray - Deep Voice of God
vestige_zhudun.description: Library voice chosen for vestige_zhudun (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: A grand, lonely, fading voice from inside amber: 'I was a sun once'. Inhuman resonance.

bogdan.name: Barovia bogdan
bogdan.description: A middle-aged farmer with a plain, nervous, rustic voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Simple, frightened, grateful.

belview.name: Barovia belview
belview.description: A rough, slurred, wheezing voice of indeterminate age, with animal snuffles and a rustic accent: one of the mongrelfolk family, speaking for all of them, wary and pitiful, sometimes darkly funny.

luvash.name: Library voice: Andrei
luvash.description: Library voice chosen for luvash (2026-10-08, recast on v3). Was: A huge man with a loud, booming, drunken voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Heartbroken and blustering, swinging between rage and tears.

order_knight.name: Library voice: Grant Gravitas - Rich, warm, cinematic
order_knight.description: Library voice chosen for order_knight (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: A hollow, distant, iron voice with an English accent, a dead knight: flat, dutiful and joyless, reciting posts and orders.

alenka.name: Library voice: Oksana
alenka.description: Library voice chosen for alenka (2026-10-08, recast on v3). Was: A young Vistani woman in her twenties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A bright, playful, teasing voice, quick and flirtatious, laughing at the gloom.

ilka_sarnov.name: Riley - Soft-Spoken and Curious
ilka_sarnov.description: A small girl of about six with a frightened, tearful child's voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent.

vestige_dahlver_nar.name: Library voice: Matthew Schmitz - Creepy Liminal Entity
vestige_dahlver_nar.description: Library voice chosen for vestige_dahlver_nar (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: Many borrowed voices from inside amber, overlapping, repeating words in threes. Inhuman resonance.

grigor.name: Barovia grigor
grigor.description: A grizzled hunter with a gruff, hard, outdoor voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Terse, practical, suspicious.

danika_martikov.name: Barovia Danika Martikova (2026-10-08)
danika_martikov.description: A Barovian innkeeper's wife in her forties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A warm, brisk, practical motherly voice, quick and dry, that turns frosty with bullies and loud when shouting at her boys.

vestige_drizlash.name: Library voice: Lex - Sinister, Whispering Goblin
vestige_drizlash.description: Library voice chosen for vestige_drizlash (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: A skittering, whispering, repetitive voice from inside the walls: 'I see, I see, I see'. Inhuman resonance.

vestige_sykane.name: Library voice: Monika Sogam – Sinister Creepy Voice
vestige_sykane.description: Library voice chosen for vestige_sykane (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: A whining, gasping, hungry voice from inside amber, polite until it isn't. Inhuman resonance.

vestige_yrrga.name: Library voice: Kristen – Cold Evil Queen Villain
vestige_yrrga.description: Library voice chosen for vestige_yrrga (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: A cold, clinical voice from inside amber, full of pity for the blind. Inhuman resonance.

vestige_seriach.name: Library voice: Matthew Schmitz - Unholy, Wicked Demon
vestige_seriach.description: Library voice chosen for vestige_seriach (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: A huntsman's proud, growling voice from inside amber, boasting of its burning hounds. Inhuman resonance.

vestige_tenebrous.name: Library voice: Matthew Schmitz - The Whispering Spirit of the Gentle Calm
vestige_tenebrous.description: Library voice chosen for vestige_tenebrous (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: A hushing whisper from the dark inside amber, 'shh', hating light like noise. Inhuman resonance.

vestige_savnok.name: Library voice: Glenn - SleepStory, Whisper & Gravely
vestige_savnok.description: Library voice chosen for vestige_savnok (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: Almost silence: a breathy, secretive voice from inside amber speaking in ellipses. Inhuman resonance.

gustav_durst.name: Barovia gustav_durst
gustav_durst.description: A man with a smooth, oily, genteel voice gone rasping and wet, a courteous host who is now a ghast: polite, ingratiating and hungry. Strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent.

ilya_krezkov.name: Ryan Quin
ilya_krezkov.description: A boy of eight with a hoarse, feverish but lively, curious child's voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent.

thorn.name: Kavya - Cute & Engaging Character
thorn.description: A boy of about seven with a small, whimpering, clingy child's voice and a faint ghostly echo. Frightened of being left alone.

durst_nursemaid.name: Barovia durst_nursemaid
durst_nursemaid.description: A woman's ghostly, whispering, grief-hollowed voice, crooning and lost, asking for her baby, with an eerie echo.

phantom_warden.name: Library voice: Jim Executive - Authoritative, British & Warm
phantom_warden.description: Library voice chosen for phantom_warden (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: A man's hollow, ghostly, stern voice with an English accent, a gate guard demanding the right words; weary and suspicious.

vistana.name: Barovia vistana
vistana.description: A woman in her thirties with a wry, dry, observant voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Off duty and unimpressed, but urgent when it matters.

vasilka.name: Barovia vasilka
vasilka.description: A young woman's beautiful, smooth, perfectly flat and polite voice, a stitched bride who knows etiquette and nothing else: affectless, courteous, eerily empty.

kolyan_indirovich.name: Barovia kolyan_indirovich
kolyan_indirovich.description: An old man's tired, dignified, fading voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent, the late burgomaster speaking from a letter or memory: formal, grave and loving.

cult_shades.name: Barovia cult_shades
cult_shades.description: A chorus of hollow, whispering, overlapping voices speaking as one: robed shadows chanting and pleading, cold and insistent.

vestige_yog.name: Library voice: K. V. Hagen - Exceptionally Deep Bass
vestige_yog.description: Library voice chosen for vestige_yog (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: An enormous, slow, monosyllabic voice through the floor, with long pauses; immovable. Inhuman resonance.

sergei_von_zarovich.name: Nikolay Ivanov - Warm, Joyful, and Rich
sergei_von_zarovich.description: A young man with a gentle, clear, noble voice and a noticeable old-world Eastern European accent, heard as if through water: kind, calm and full of longing.

mirabel.name: Library voice: Roxana
mirabel.description: Library voice chosen for mirabel (2026-10-08, recast on v3). Was: A Vistani woman in her forties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent, heavy on every word. A deep, throaty, laughing voice; loves a good story and bad wine; warm and knowing.

arik.name: Library voice: MRV - Conversational
arik.description: Library voice chosen for arik (2026-10-08, recast on v3). Was: A grey, unhurried man with a flat, toneless, empty voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Answers with the fewest words possible; nobody behind the eyes.

elisabeth_durst.name: Barovia elisabeth_durst
elisabeth_durst.description: A woman with a sharp, cold, aristocratic voice turned rasping and hungry, a ghoul and a true believer: righteous, contemptuous and impatient. Strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent.

toma_sarnov.name: Teddy Twinkle - Cute Cartoon
toma_sarnov.description: A small boy of about five with a frightened, whispery child's voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent.

amber_sentinel.name: Library voice: Dante - Growly and Menacing Monster
amber_sentinel.description: Library voice chosen for amber_sentinel (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: A vast, booming, inhuman voice speaking in short commands, like stone grinding under a mountain; slow, absolute, echoing.

tsolenka_watchman.name: Barovia tsolenka_watchman
tsolenka_watchman.description: A dead watchman's hollow, rasping, distant voice, strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent.

hedda_ironvow.name: Barovia hedda_ironvow
hedda_ironvow.description: A dwarven woman in her middle years with a low, warm, earthy alto and a soft Scottish lilt. Slow, measured and unhurried, letting pauses do the work; dry humour and quiet kindness, weary contempt for the undead, loud and resonant only when she prays.

ilse_varga.name: Barovia ilse_varga
ilse_varga.description: A woman in her late thirties with a husky, clipped, no-nonsense voice and a light German accent, a veteran mercenary sergeant. Short declarative sentences in a military rhythm, counting things out loud; blunt and calm, quieter and more precise when afraid.

silvain_aster.name: Barovia silvain_aster
silvain_aster.description: An ageless, androgynous elven scholar with a light, precise, crisp voice between tenor and alto and a refined English accent. Elaborate, formal, complete sentences; pedantic, always correcting, dryly witty; more exact and faster when frightened.

tamsin_tealeaf.name: Barovia tamsin_tealeaf
tamsin_tealeaf.description: A small, cheerful halfling man with a quick, bright, chatty tenor and a light Irish lilt. Long sentences that run downhill to a punchline; warm, mischievous and charming, talks to locks; goes suddenly silent when truly frightened.

hero_female.name: Lucie - Clear and Professional Actress
hero_female.description: A warm adult woman's voice with a neutral English accent for a custom player hero: clear, grounded and expressive, able to carry any class or temperament.
hero_female.model_note: Coordinator for the owner, 2026-10-08 23:16: new custom-hero lines on eleven_v4, no tags, to match their 642 v4 clips (SND-01).

hero_male.name: Julian Vale - Resonant and Optimistic
hero_male.description: A warm adult man's voice with a neutral English accent for a custom player hero: resonant, grounded and expressive, able to carry any class or temperament.
hero_male.model_note: Coordinator for the owner, 2026-10-08 23:16: new custom-hero lines on eleven_v4, no tags, to match their 642 v4 clips (SND-01).

anastrasya_karelova.name: Dasha - Warm, Serious, and Smooth

volenta_popofsky.description: Library voice chosen for Volenta Popofsky: Nadya - Energetic and Clear.
volenta_popofsky.name: Nadya - Energetic and Clear

kip_smudgewick.name: Barovia Kip Smudgewick
kip_smudgewick.description: A friendly, anxious tiefling man of about fifty with a warm, quick, slightly breathless baritone and a soft West Country English accent. A fast-talking market-stall salesman, polite and eager to please, apologising and selling at once; slow, careful and hard as nails when he is cornered. (Updated 2026-10-07: about fifty, Pip is his daughter; the voice is unchanged, the owner's pick.)

liriel_dawnsong.name: Barovia Liriel Dawnsong
liriel_dawnsong.description: A slight elven woman, ageless but young, with a soft, clear, bell-like soprano and a gentle Welsh lilt. Serene, musical and formal, unhurried and kind; a quiet steel underneath, and rare moments of dry wit. Becomes very still and precise when her faith is tested.

ratatoille.name: Barovia Ratatoille
ratatoille.description: A young elven man with a light, quick, slightly nasal tenor and a French accent. Fussy, precise and eager, talking fast and rising in pitch when excited, voice occasionally cracking; pompous on purpose, warm by accident, and very quiet and proud when someone loves his food.

thistle.name: Barovia Thistle
thistle.description: A young woman in her early twenties with a loud, raspy, earthy alto and a broad rural Scottish accent. Boisterous and blunt, laughing big and talking short, a wild woodswoman with no manners and a huge heart; goes completely quiet and low when she is grieving.

wren_featherfoot.name: Barovia Wren Featherfoot
wren_featherfoot.description: A small, quick halfling man in his late twenties with a bright, wry, nimble tenor and a London accent. Fast-talking, cheeky and light, always ready with a comeback, laughing at his own jokes; very calm, quiet and short when he is angry or grieving.

godrick_pendlebrook.name: Barovia Godrick Pendlebrook
godrick_pendlebrook.description: A golden, handsome young knight with a rich, velvety baritone and a polished English accent. Arrogant charm and wry humour, relaxed and teasing, a sardonic half-smile in every line; brave and sincere when it counts, never shouting.

fen_burley.name: Library voice: Adam - Classic Scottish Storyteller
fen_burley.description: Library voice chosen for fen_burley (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: An old man in his seventies with a rough, low, gravelly voice and a rural Scottish accent like Thistle's, a woodsman of very few words. Slow and plain, long silences, tender underneath; a wolf's growl rising under the words when he struggles.

mister_quillon.name: Library voice: Lance Blackwood - Sinister, Posh & British
mister_quillon.description: Library voice chosen for mister_quillon (2026-10-08, v3 re-record). Was: A slim, ageless gentleman with a soft, smooth, precise tenor and a crisp, upper-class English accent, a devil playing a solicitor. Courteous, patient and faintly amused, never raising his voice; thin and very quiet when cornered.

bark_bandit.name: Viktor - Bold, Slavic and Impatient
bark_bandit.description: A Barovian highwayman: a rough, impatient man with a strong Eastern European accent, sneering and greedy.

bark_bandit_captain.name: Roderich - Crude & Ruthless
bark_bandit_captain.description: A bandit captain: an older, crude, ruthless man who barks orders and enjoys it.

bark_guard.name: Maksim - Raw Unpolished Deep
bark_guard.description: A Vallaki guard: a deep, blunt, tired Barovian voice with an Eastern European accent.

bark_berserker.name: Harry - Fierce Warrior
bark_berserker.description: A berserker: a wild young man shouting with bloodlust.

bark_cultist.name: Valerian | The Nihilist Evil
bark_cultist.description: A cultist of the night: intense, fervent and unhinged.

bark_witch.name: Horpyna - Village Witch & Trickster
bark_witch.description: A Barovian witch: a cackling, mocking woman with an Eastern European accent.

bark_druid.name: Elinor | The Gruff Aunt
bark_druid.description: A Yester Hill druid: a gruff, old woman, fierce and earthy.

bark_mongrelfolk.name: Valf - Goblin, Raspy, Fantasy Monster
bark_mongrelfolk.description: A mongrelfolk: a raspy, broken, creature-like voice, eager and childish.

bark_vampire_spawn.name: Ilinca | The Vampire Countess
bark_vampire_spawn.description: A vampire spawn: a hungry, silky woman's voice with a Russian accent, hissing at the edges.

bark_hag.name: Nadine – Whispering Witch of the Black Forest
bark_hag.description: A night hag: a whispering, sinister old woman, sweet and poisonous.

bark_revenant.name: Greg - Ghostly, Gritty, Brave and Raspy
bark_revenant.description: A revenant: a gritty, raspy, ghostly man driven only by vengeance.

bark_wight.name: Gravel Midnight – Deep Grit Character Voice
bark_wight.description: A wight: an old, cold, commanding undead lord with a dry, rasping, grave-dust voice, contemptuous of the living.

bark_ogre.name: Azgar - Indimidating Orc Troll
bark_ogre.description: An ogre: a huge, deep, slow and stupid brute.

bark_werewolf.name: Dracon - Feral, Demonic & Dangerous
bark_werewolf.description: A werewolf: a feral, snarling, raspy man halfway to a beast.

bark_phantom_knight.name: Xavier - Big, Deep & Powerful narrator
bark_phantom_knight.description: A phantom knight of the Order of the Silver Dragon: big, deep and noble, sworn to an old oath.

bark_arcanaloth.name: Malyx - Echoey, Menacing and Deep Demon
bark_arcanaloth.description: An arcanaloth: an echoing, menacing, deep fiend with a lawyer's patience.

noise_wolf.description: Noises for wolf, dire_wolf in fights.

noise_flame.description: Noises for flameskull, fire_elemental in fights.

krezk_woodcutter.description: A middle-aged Krezk woodcutter with a gruff, plain, weathered voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Few words, wary and tired.
krezk_woodcutter.name: Barovia krezk_woodcutter

vallaki_goodwife.name: Barovia vallaki_goodwife
vallaki_goodwife.description: A Vallaki market woman in her fifties with a brisk, chatty, sharp voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Gossipy, nervous under forced festival cheer.

vallaki_carter.description: A burly carter in his forties with a loud, rough, good-natured voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Grumbles about hauling for the Baron's festivals.
vallaki_carter.name: Barovia vallaki_carter

vallaki_lamplighter.name: Library voice: Bogdan  Gamaleț
vallaki_lamplighter.description: Ilie the Lamplighter of Vallaki, a grieving father; library voice (2026-10-08). Was: An old lamplighter with a thin, quiet, careful voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Superstitious about the dark, speaks softly.

vallaki_grumbler.name: Barovia vallaki_grumbler
vallaki_grumbler.description: A sour man in his fifties locked in the stocks for insufficient cheer, with a sardonic, grumbling, nasal voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent.

barovia_goodwife.name: Barovia barovia_goodwife
barovia_goodwife.description: A worn village woman of Barovia in her forties with a low, tired, frightened voice and a strong, clearly audible Eastern European (Romanian) accent. Keeps her shutters closed.

vadoma.name: Barovia Vadoma (2026-10-08)
vadoma.description: A Vistani trader woman in her forties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A warm, low, slightly husky voice; dry, quick and amused, a merchant's patter with a knife inside it.

tser_radu.name: Library voice: Doru
tser_radu.description: A charming Vistani horse trader with a rhythmic, sweet-talking Romanian storyteller's voice.

tser_tobar.name: Library voice: Serban Popescu - Professional Narrator
tser_tobar.description: A huge, gentle Vistani wheelwright; a warm, deep Romanian voice.

tser_zora.name: Library voice: Elena - Textured, warm, and expressive
tser_zora.description: A watchful young Vistani lookout; a textured, slightly raspy voice with an Eastern European cadence.

tser_dorina.name: Barovia tser_dorina
tser_dorina.description: An old Vistani woman in her seventies speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A warm, crackly, bossy grandmother's voice, dry and wry, who feeds everyone at the camp's stewpot.

tser_petru.name: Library voice: Paul - Engaging, Friendly and Mysterious
tser_petru.description: A terse Vistani knife-sharpener and camp guard; a low, mysterious Transylvanian voice.

barovia_woodcutter.name: Barovia barovia_woodcutter (2026-10-08)
barovia_woodcutter.description: A weathered Barovian woodcutter in his fifties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent. A gruff, rough, breathy working man's voice, hurried and superstitious.

barovia_widow.name: Barovia barovia_widow (2026-10-08)
barovia_widow.description: An old Barovian widow in her sixties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent. A soft, dry, wry voice with a tremor of grief, gentle and plain-spoken.

barovia_gravedigger.name: Barovia barovia_gravedigger (2026-10-08)
barovia_gravedigger.description: A big, slow Barovian sexton in his sixties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent. A deep, gravelly, unhurried voice, matter-of-fact about the dead, oddly courteous.

barovia_vasile.name: Barovia barovia_vasile (2026-10-08)
barovia_vasile.description: A thin, hooded Barovian villager in his forties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent. A reedy, hushed gossip's voice, eager to tell the worst news.

barovia_petre.name: Barovia barovia_petre (2026-10-08)
barovia_petre.description: A threadbare Barovian man in his fifties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent. A low, gloomy, dry voice, contrary and fatalistic.

barovia_acolyte.name: Library voice: Maria - Calm & Friendly
barovia_acolyte.description: Anca, the church's girl (15): a young adult library voice, the owner's pick (2026-10-08).

camp_cook.description: An old Vistani woman in her seventies speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A tart, crackly, bossy old cook's voice with a sly humour.

krezk_goatherd.description: Stelian, goatherd of krezk: a generic townsperson on a shared voice, Mihai (also Urwin Martikov's). Owner rule 2026-10-08: minor townsfolk share voices.

wine_pruner.description: Ovidiu, vine-dresser of the wizard of wines: a generic townsperson on a shared voice, Mihai (also Urwin Martikov's). Owner rule 2026-10-08: minor townsfolk share voices.

camp_groom.name: Barovia Gavril
camp_groom.description: An old Vistani horse-keeper in his sixties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A low, gentle, dry old voice, more at ease with horses.

pastry_customer_man.name: Library voice: Cristi Romana
pastry_customer_man.description: Iulian, waiting at the mill: a generic townsperson on a shared voice, Cristi Romana (also Krezk Watchman's). Owner rule 2026-10-08: minor townsfolk share voices.

tser_marin.description: Old Marin, hunter of the tser pool camp: a generic townsperson on a shared voice, Cristi Romana (also Krezk Watchman's). Owner rule 2026-10-08: minor townsfolk share voices.

vallaki_patron_dragan.description: Dragan, a drinker at the blue water inn: a generic townsperson on a shared voice, Doru (also Radu's). Owner rule 2026-10-08: minor townsfolk share voices.

wine_cooper.description: Old Silviu, cooper of the wizard of wines: a generic townsperson on a shared voice, Ciprian Pop - Friendly and Reflective (also Henrik van der Voort's). Owner rule 2026-10-08: minor townsfolk share voices.

camp_lookout.description: Mihnea, lookout of the lake camp: a generic townsperson on a shared voice, Dmitry - Clear and Energetic (also Escher's). Owner rule 2026-10-08: minor townsfolk share voices.

krezk_gate_boy.description: Dumitru, a boy of krezk: a generic townsperson on a shared voice, Kavya - Cute & Engaging Character (also Thorn's). Owner rule 2026-10-08: minor townsfolk share voices.

ana.description: Ana, the lamplighter's daughter: the owner's casting-room pick (2026-10-08), library voice Yoana.

vallaki_ribbon_girl.name: Library voice: Yoana - Fresh, bright, and engaging
vallaki_ribbon_girl.description: Daciana, festival ribbon seller: the owner's casting-room pick (2026-10-08), library voice Yoana.

barovia_shopper.name: Barovia Goodwife Viorica
barovia_shopper.description: A thin, anxious Barovian goodwife in her forties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A tight, worried, complaining voice that drops low and wary.

barovia_worshipper_mihai.name: Barovia Old Florin
barovia_worshipper_mihai.description: An old Barovian man in his seventies speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A thin, dry, cracked voice, sad and wry, a churchgoer with no illusions.

barovia_worshipper_sorina.name: Barovia Goodwife Sorina
barovia_worshipper_sorina.description: A Barovian goodwife in her fifties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A soft, hushed, nervous church voice, devout and watchful.

vallaki_herbwife.name: Barovia Old Smaranda
vallaki_herbwife.description: A bent old Vallaki herbwife in her seventies speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A cracked, sweet, conspiratorial old voice, smiling hard and talking low.

vallaki_cloth_merchant.name: Barovia Master Costel
vallaki_cloth_merchant.description: A plump Vallaki cloth merchant in his fifties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A loud, jolly, salesman's voice with a nervous edge underneath.

vallaki_porter.name: Barovia Matei
vallaki_porter.description: A huge, cheerful Vallaki porter in his thirties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A big, warm, breathless, genuinely happy voice.

vallaki_raker.name: Barovia Gheorghe
vallaki_raker.description: A hooded Vallaki street raker in his forties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A flat, weary, deadpan voice, worn down by pointless orders.

vallaki_patrol.name: Barovia Watchman Dobre
vallaki_patrol.description: A Vallaki town watchman in his thirties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A brusque, bored, officious voice with a forced smile in it.

vallaki_sun_painter.name: Barovia Tudor
vallaki_sun_painter.description: A hooded Vallaki painter in his forties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A dry, sardonic, tired craftsman's voice.

teodor.name: Barovia Teodor
teodor.description: A Barovian cooper turned vampire spawn, in his forties, speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A quiet, courteous, hollow voice, starving underneath, gentle and sad, with a cold edge.

barovia_luca.name: Barovia Luca
barovia_luca.description: A broad-shouldered Barovian woodcutter's son, nineteen, speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A young, earnest, slightly hoarse voice, shaken and sheepish.

stella_wachter.name: Barovia Stella Wachter
stella_wachter.description: A clever, wilful young Vallaki noblewoman of twenty speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A bright, sharp, well-bred voice, fierce and shaken after two years under a curse.

vallaki_chandler.name: Barovia Pyotr Petrov
vallaki_chandler.description: A broad, anxious Vallaki chandler in his forties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A worried, breathless, earnest father's voice.

tser_lavinia.name: Barovia Lavinia
tser_lavinia.description: A Vistani dancer in her twenties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A bright, sly, teasing, breathless voice.

tser_iancu.name: Barovia Iancu
tser_iancu.description: A young Vistani knife-thrower speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A cool, intense, quiet young man's voice, never satisfied.

wine_picker.name: Barovia Andrei
wine_picker.description: A big, quiet Barovian grape picker in his thirties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A deep, slow, gentle voice with a mouth half full.

sorin_krezkov.name: Barovia Sorin
sorin_krezkov.description: A huge, bent, goat-legged man of about thirty, reshaped at an abbey, speaking English with a strong Romanian accent. A soft, hoarse, eerie, gentle voice, slow and halting, uncanny when it mimics others.

zinaida.name: Barovia Zinaida
zinaida.description: The ghost of a young Barovian bride of nineteen who drowned herself in a well forty years ago, speaking English with a strong Romanian accent. A cold, echoing, waterlogged voice that rises from a whisper to a wailing scream.

tser_nelu.name: Barovia Nelu
tser_nelu.description: A Vistani young man of about twenty, slight and wiry, speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A light, boyish tenor gone hoarse from shouting, raw and shaky with cold and fear, but stubborn and wry underneath, the sort who jokes to keep from crying.

szoldar.name: Barovia Szoldar
szoldar.description: A Barovian hunter in his fifties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A low, gravelly, weathered voice, gruff and sardonic, a man who sits with his back to the wall; tired, guarded and quietly ashamed underneath.

yevgeni.name: Barovia Yevgeni
yevgeni.description: A Barovian young man of nineteen speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A soft, earnest, slightly husky young man's voice, shy and quiet, honest and anxious, braver than he sounds.

marshal_dragomir.name: Barovia Marshal Dragomir
marshal_dragomir.description: An ancient undead cavalry marshal, a man's skeleton four hundred years dead, speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A deep, hollow, dry, rasping voice with a faint echo of an empty helmet; stern, formal and clipped like an officer giving orders, proud and unbending, weary beyond measure.

krezk_dragos.name: Barovia Dragos
krezk_dragos.description: A big, bearded Barovian ferryman in his forties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A deep, rough, hoarse boatman's voice, worn ragged from a year of shouting; grieving and desperate, but warm, stubborn and wry underneath.

krezk_carver.name: Barovia Old Pavel
krezk_carver.description: An old hooded Krezk carver in his seventies speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A thin, patient, devout old voice.

pool_grave_keeper.name: Barovia Old Simion
pool_grave_keeper.description: An old Krezk grave-keeper in his seventies speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A slow, dry, kindly, creaking old voice.

bonegrinder_mouse.name: Library voice: Mithi - Moral Kids Stories Character
bonegrinder_mouse.description: Mouse (Zamfira), Morgantha's fourth, a girl of twelve turning into a hag: chosen by Claude on the owner's go-ahead (2026-10-08), library voice Mithi over Yuna and Tilly for the most childlike pitch.

granny_ash.name: Barovia Granny Ash
granny_ash.description: An enormous, ancient annis hag of the deep Barovian woods, an old woman twice a man's height with iron teeth, speaking English with a strong Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants. A deep, cracked, gravelly old woman's voice, syrupy-sweet like a doting grandmother on top and hungry and monstrous underneath; slow, amused, terribly patient.

goodwife_sarnov.name: Barovia Goodwife Sarnov
goodwife_sarnov.description: A worn-out Barovian village mother in her thirties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A tired, hollow, low woman's voice, flat with grief and guilt, plain and unadorned, cracking when hope gets in.

count_huntsman.name: Barovia The Huntsman
count_huntsman.description: A long-dead Barovian huntsman, a revenant four hundred years in the saddle, speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A low, dry, hoarse man's voice, cold and formal like an old servant reciting rules, bone-weary under it, with a faint echo of the grave.

belview_mother.name: Barovia Mother (Belview)
belview_mother.description: A broad, grey-haired Barovian woman of about sixty, born in Krezk, speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A low, husky, slow and very calm voice that never rises, with a faint feline purr and rasp in it; motherly, weary, quietly stubborn, strange.

argynvostholt_cosmin.name: Barovia Cosmin
argynvostholt_cosmin.description: A Barovian youth of eighteen from Vallaki, a cooper's son, speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A light, boyish, earnest young voice, a little hoarse from the cold, stubborn and proud, trying hard to sound braver than he is.

tinker_iosif.name: Barovia Iosif the Tinker
tinker_iosif.description: A thin Vistani tinker in his forties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A quick, bright, patter-merchant's voice, cheerful and wheedling at top speed, with frantic fear just under the smile.

mother_ecaterina.name: Barovia Mother Ecaterina
mother_ecaterina.description: A Barovian woman in her forties from Vallaki, frozen alive in ice for forty years, speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A small, faint, slow, breathy voice, numb with cold and grief, gentle and very tired, every word an effort.

bray_martikov.name: Library voice: Ryan Quin
bray_martikov.description: Bray Martikov, ten, a wereraven boy of the Blue Water Inn: a child's library voice (also Ilya Krezkov's, in Krezk), chosen by Claude on the owner's go-ahead while credits were short (2026-10-08).

count_fowler.name: Library voice: Dmitry - Clear and Energetic
count_fowler.description: The Fowler, a vampire spawn of the castle with one line: a shared library voice (also Escher's, another of the count's spawn), chosen by Claude while credits were short (2026-10-08).

krezk_petru.name: Library voice: Austin - Timid and Casual
krezk_petru.description: Petru, eight, of the farms below Krezk, half a werewolf: chosen by Claude on the owner's go-ahead (2026-10-08), the library boy's voice Austin (a timid orphan boy) over Quang Anh and Don Kim.

the_grandsire.name: Barovia The Grandsire
the_grandsire.description: An ancient werewolf, the eldest of a Barovian pack, a wolf the size of a cart horse, speaking English with a strong Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants. An enormous, deep, slow, gravelly voice like a grave being dug, half growl, old and patient, possessive and menacing, with a wolf's snarl at the edges.

corvina.name: Barovia Corvina
corvina.description: A young woman of about twenty-two, a wizard's apprentice from beyond the mists, forty years a vampire spawn, speaking with a crisp, educated English accent. A clear, dry, quick and clever voice gone cold and hollow, slow now as if reading words off a page, with flashes of her old impatience and wit; tired, gentle, haunted.

ilarion.name: Barovia Ilarion
ilarion.description: A young Barovian villager in his late twenties speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A soft, gentle, hoarse voice, tired from a night in the cold, confused and earnest, polite and anxious, a loving husband and father.

sarkhaza.name: Barovia Sarkhaza
sarkhaza.description: An immense, ancient red dragoness, chained and starved for forty years, speaking English in a deep, smoky, resonant female voice with a crackle of fire in the throat. Regal, sly and amused, every courtesy a hunger; slow, purring menace that can rise to a roar.

ghakis_doina.name: Barovia Doina
ghakis_doina.description: A Barovian charcoal-burner woman in her thirties from the woods below Krezk, speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A hoarse, practical, steady voice, smoke-roughened, shaken but brave and down-to-earth.

ghakis_petrache.name: Barovia Petrache
ghakis_petrache.description: A Barovian charcoal-burner man in his forties from the woods below Krezk, speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A slow, low, gravelly, laconic voice, dry and watchful, a man who listens more than he talks.

khazan.name: Barovia Khazan
khazan.description: An ancient lich, archmage to the old kings of a Carpathian valley, speaking English with a faint, cultured old-world Eastern European accent. A dry, papery, thin old man's voice with a faint hollow echo, courteous and scholarly, delighted by visitors like a lonely librarian, with something hungry and cold just underneath.

the_eye_below.name: Barovia The Eye Below
the_eye_below.description: A vast, ancient beholder, an alien floating eye-monster sealed in amber for a thousand years and half asleep, speaking English slowly and dreamily. A deep, wet, resonant voice with a whispery, many-throated hiss under it, drowsy and childlike in its curiosity, paranoid and imperious, gleefully hungry to see again.

yester_zorica.name: Barovia Zorica
yester_zorica.description: A Barovian young woman of about eighteen, the youngest druid of a hill circle, speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A light, raw, girlish voice, fierce with grief and accusation, stubborn and proud, trembling underneath, a little wild.

lantern_girl.name: Library voice: Yuna - Playful, Bright & Curious
lantern_girl.description: Liliana, the Lantern Girl, Old Sabin's daughter drowned at the Baron's first festival: chosen by Claude on the owner's go-ahead (2026-10-09), the library girl's voice Yuna over Mini and Sammy (the most childlike and wistful).

vallaki_sandu.name: Library voice: Austin - Timid and Casual
vallaki_sandu.description: Sandu, nine, Old Sabin's grandson, two lines: a shared library boy's voice (also Little Petru's, in Krezk), chosen by Claude.

vallaki_sabin.name: Barovia Old Sabin
vallaki_sabin.description: An old Barovian lantern-maker in his seventies from Vallaki, speaking English with a very strong, thick Romanian accent: rolled r's, hard consonants, foreign vowels. A soft, cracked, gentle old man's voice, tired and grieving, trembling with worry for his grandson, tender and bewildered.

sfx.note: Creature noises in fights (noise_<kind>, narrative/combat/barks.json) are ElevenLabs sound effects, billed 20 credits a second at a set length; usd_per_credit is the Creator plan's $22 per 100,000 credits.
